# BrowserLab - Browser Extensions for AI Platforms

> BrowserLab is the fastest free method to organize, export, and manage Google Gemini chats. 20,000+ users trust BrowserLab Chrome extensions.

Website: https://browserlab.io
Contact: hamzaw31@gmail.com

## Extensions

### Toolbox for Gemini
The all-in-one Chrome extension for Google Gemini. Features folders, PDF export, bulk delete, and prompt library.
- Rating: 4.7 stars (5,000+ users)
- Price: Free (Pro features optional)
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/gemini-toolbox/cbdpdhfnjbkjphmminnkfbeekodlphlp
- Website: https://browserlab.io/toolbox-for-gemini

### SaveChat for Gemini (PDF Export)
Export Gemini conversations to clean, professional PDFs. Preserve formatting, code blocks, and images.
- Rating: 4.7 stars
- Price: Free
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/gemini-to-pdf/blndbnmpkgfoopgmcejnhdnepfejgipe
- Website: https://browserlab.io/save-chat-for-gemini

### Bulk Delete for Gemini
Delete hundreds of Gemini chats in seconds. Select all or pick specific conversations to remove at once.
- Rating: 4.7 stars
- Price: Free
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/gemini-bulk-delete/bdbdcppgiiidaolmadifdlceedoojpfh
- Website: https://browserlab.io/bulk-delete-for-gemini

### Copy YouTube Transcript
One-click YouTube transcript copying. Works with regular videos and Shorts.
- Rating: 4.9 stars (10,000+ users)
- Price: Free
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/copy-youtube-transcript/mpfdnefhgmjlbkphfpkiicdaegfanbab
- Website: https://browserlab.io/transcript-for-youtube

## Key Features

**For Gemini Users:**
- Organize chats with folders and custom categories
- Export conversations to PDF, HTML, Markdown, or JSON
- Bulk delete multiple chats in 30 seconds (vs 15+ minutes manually)
- Save and reuse prompts with the prompt library

**For YouTube Users:**
- Copy full video transcripts with one click
- Include or exclude timestamps
- AI-ready output for ChatGPT/Claude analysis

## Privacy & Security
- All data stays in your browser - we never collect or store conversations
- Minimal permissions - only requests access to specific sites
- No ads, no tracking, no data selling
- Independent developer - not affiliated with Google LLC

- Huzzler Launch Arena First Place Winner (multiple extensions)
